guideNote: Official names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them (the list as carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles). Every guide below was written for this app, in its own words, drawing on the launch-week guides named in each trophy's sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned; there is nothing separate to do for it. Plan around roughly 200 hours: the story is only the first stretch, and A Long Road (100% completion) is the long tail. There are no online, difficulty or mission-medal trophies, so one careful playthrough with a manual save kept at the start of every chapter is enough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It pops on completion and cannot be missed while playing the story; note that chapter trophies in this game can land at the start of the following chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so do not panic if one is a beat late.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you close the chapter out, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude): it appears during Chapter 1 and is gone for good afterwards. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter as well — the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. During this chapter, switching between Jason and Lucia and calling the other in as your partner opens up, which unlocks the duo trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best). The Kingpin Bowling operation behind Let's Go Bowling is also visited in Chapter 2, and the missions Daily Driver and Moses open the garage and Scooter Bros apps used by Little Boxes and On the Spot.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This chapter opens jewelry robberies through Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which hands you the Snap Gun (see Sneakthief), and it holds the time-sensitive Race Against Yago strand race: start that race the moment it appears (hourglass icon) instead of leaving it for later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of the chapter, pick up the optional mission That's Where The Money Is: it unlocks the bank vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal (and a fast Hot Together) are built on.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission; the story wraps up in Chapter 5. Before you start it, park one untouched manual save and never overwrite it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your only way back. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It sits on the campaign's critical path, so it unlocks simply by playing the story in order.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist during the campaign. Launch-week roadmaps list it among the side beats worth clearing as they appear in stage 1 rather than leaving them to pile up.
sources: LF Carry — GTA 6 Platinum Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. A main-path mission trophy: complete the mission and it pops, sometimes at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is unmissable as long as you play the campaign through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is Vice City International Airport — the same airfield where Catch Me If You Can is earned later in free roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A main-path mission trophy that pops on completion as you work through the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). The checklist only appears after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts. It does not demand literally everything: published breakdowns put it at 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of the 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults and 300 stunts — which is why 250 stunts, 50 Challenges and 100 vehicles are only waypoints. Work this last, after the story and side stories.
sources: LF Carry — GTA 6 Platinum Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the same counter. They are scattered across Leonida, so tag them as you explore instead of grinding them at the end — and keep going afterwards, because 100% completion wants 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games and the rest. Trying one of each is enough: you do not need to win, medal or finish high for this one, so knock it out early while you are learning the map.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, split across the game's two shooting ranges. Golds are about accuracy and time rather than firepower: learn each challenge's target pattern, then replay immediately while the layout is fresh in your hands.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough — you do not need every race variant at a location, so move on as soon as a location is ticked off.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeating the same race does not add to the counter. Mix street races with the other race types as you travel Leonida, and grab the Chapter 3 Race Against Yago strand race when it appears, because that one is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types sampled for Master of None; take Cal's challenge when it is offered and land your catches cleanly to out-score him. Launch-week checklists place a first shot at Cal as early as Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Finishing it is enough — no high score is required — which makes this one of the quickest bronzes on the list and an easy Chapter 1 tick.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's questline and complete his final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, and side-story finales stay available after the credits, so this can be cleaned up post-story. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's questline and complete his final mission. Like the other side-story finales, it remains available after the story ends, so there is no need to rush it mid-campaign.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's questline and complete his final mission. Billy's strand carries its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — check that trophy's progress counter if you are counting strands.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.timeSensitiveNote: Some strands are time-sensitive (hourglass icon) — Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is the known one. Start a strand the moment it appears rather than parking it.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some questlines count: the named side stories that carry their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone and friends) do not, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to confirm it registered. Watch for hourglass strands — Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive, so start it the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's questline and complete his final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so this is safe cleanup material whenever you reach it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's questline and complete his final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and carries its own trophy, so it does not count toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: One spot is missable: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating with your partner along may count a spot for both characters, so bring them. THE MISSABLE ONE: during Chapter 1, after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — the morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time — and follow her out onto the balcony of Jason's house to accept the optional meditation. It disappears when Chapter 1 ends. It is not fully confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that exact spot, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and works through target decks; when you line up the shot, a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. The cards sit out in the open world across Leonida, so sweep them region by region during the exploration pass you make for The Goodtime State rather than hunting a whole set in one trip.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is also how you scan vehicles for Whip It Good, so make it a habit in every new area: scan, shoot, move on, and the two counters climb together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, tracked under Progress > Challenges. There are 80 of them in eight categories of ten, and many tick off on their own as you play; since 100% completion asks for 70, this trophy normally lands on the way there.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner called in (partner play opens during Chapter 2), earn a 4-star Wanted Level and lose it completely; the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. A bank vault job hands you 4 stars immediately, so escaping a vault with your partner is the natural way to earn this one.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your Wanted Level alive for the whole chain: if the stars fade down to the red heat zone, the chain breaks. Keep moving between shops, and give it a moment after the third — the trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of waiting to sit in everything. Keep going afterwards: 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus activation. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (press L3 and R3 while aiming); pick a packed group — the guards at a gang illegal operation are ideal — and work fast with an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so chain the kills quickly.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge — the jets at gates E3 and E4 work — because planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops in the air. Save first: the police response is fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The cryptic description means getting into a Rhino — a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Jewelry robberies open in Chapter 3 through Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun: use it on the store's back door, because kicking the door in trips the alarm and voids the attempt. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, empty the safe and slip out unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if you are spotted, reload and retry rather than pushing on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock near the end of Chapter 4 via the optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. Each job starts at a 4-star Wanted Level, and a vault only counts once you are clear of the heat. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The tail that opens bank vaults in That's Where The Money Is shows you where these vans run; crack one, grab the cash and lose the heat — the trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not merely the search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida so the whole state is revealed. It fills in naturally if you sweep region by region for the collectible trophies — meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK locations — instead of beelining the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations cleared, so if you rob operations as you find them, this pops on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger at launch: the official description is the only hint, so follow it literally — have the cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot with the view — and know it may simply pop during normal play. This entry is flagged honestly as unconfirmed rather than dressed up with a guessed method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. It sits in the unconfirmed-at-launch group: beyond the description there is no verified method yet, so when a showroom scene presents itself, drive out through the glass rather than the door and see the moment through.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley means robbing Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so despite the story timing it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Read the riddle as both partners at peak condition: get Jason and Lucia each to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner called in — the partner trains alongside you, so both Strength stats climb together instead of one at a time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks this one to 500: actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the counter, so over a full platinum run it fills up without a separate grind — just check the counter now and then to watch it climb.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. One of the five hidden trophies with no confirmed trigger at launch; the description points at failing once and succeeding on the retry, so do not reload out of every failure too quickly — let a failed attempt play into a second try when the game offers one.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. No confirmed trigger at launch: it is expected to pop from a scripted oddity during normal play or exploration, so when something weird starts happening, stay and let it play out instead of driving away.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. It is grouped with the unconfirmed-at-launch hidden five even though the description reads plainly, so line up a slow pass, swing as you pass, and drive on.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative across the whole run, so it accrues quietly behind the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The counter is cumulative across every kind of shop, and a platinum route sails past it — the eight garages for Little Boxes alone run to about $160,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story hands you do not count. Buy them before registering vehicles for On the Spot — every registered car needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens in the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars fitted with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each registration needs a free garage space, so sort Little Boxes first and register cheap cars.
